typeIntro.festival: Festivals are often short or mid-length peaks. Plan 2–5 nights around key dates and prioritize access to venues.
typeIntro.season: Seasonal events can run for weeks. Pick a 3–7 night window instead of staying for the entire season.
typeIntro.opera: Opera and performance seasons work best with short visits aligned to ticket dates near the venue or transit.
typeIntro.concert: Secure tickets first, then book stays close to the venue or reliable transit.
typeIntro.heritage: Heritage events may spread across districts — anchor stays near the main sites you plan to visit.
